script_text: Stop, Aries — Mars is igniting your 1st House of Self while forming a tense square to Pluto in Aquarius, and the Fire in your veins is demanding you confront something you've been avoiding. With the Sun blazing through your 9th House of Expansion, a bold truth surfaces today that reshapes how you see your path forward. In love, Venus in Cancer pours emotional depth into your 7th House of Partnerships — if you're single, this energy pulls someone authentic toward you; if taken, a conversation about hidden feelings becomes unavoidable. Career-wise, Mercury in Leo activates your 10th House of Public Status, signaling a moment where visibility and bold decisions can elevate your professional standing. Warning: don't let Mars square Pluto push you into a power struggle with someone who doesn't deserve your energy — walk away from conflict that serves no one. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
